text: A second letter, from Lord Louis Mountbatten to Admiral Andrew Cunningham, introduced Major Martin as an expert in amphibious warfare. It even included a clumsy joke about sardines, which Montagu hoped the Germans would read as a hint at Sardinia. And inside one letter, the team placed a single eyelash. If it was missing when the letter came back, they would know it had been opened.
